item.title: Palm Beach County residents hit with thousands in retroactive sewer fees from Delray Beach
item.description: Homeowners along Franwood Drive in unincorporated Palm Beach County received notices from Delray Beach demanding back payments for up to three years of sewer fees, with some bills exceeding $4,000.

item.title: Martin County free clinic sees surge in patients after federal health subsidies expired
item.description: Volunteers in Medicine in Martin County is treating more patients after enhanced Affordable Care Act subsidies expired at the start of this year, leaving many low-income residents without health insurance.

item.title: North Palm Beach celebrates Fourth of July with fireworks, pool party at North Palm Beach Country Club
item.description: North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse will host Independence Day celebrations on July 4 with a full day of activities, live entertainment and a 9 p.m. fireworks finale.

item.title: TikTok, Google ignore Florida child social media safety law while Meta complies
item.description: Most major tech companies are not complying with Florida's landmark social media law banning children under 14 from creating accounts, despite the law taking effect after a federal appeals court cleared it in November.
